title: Verdict
description: The axiom exit gate result. Pass or fail, with specific blockers on failure.

verdict.description: Whether the artifact meets its criteria

finding.description: What was found — specific, actionable, not generic

location.description: File path and line number if applicable

blockers.description: Required when verdict is fail. Each blocker must give the producing agent enough information to fix the issue.

verdict_summary.description: One paragraph readable by a human or orchestrator. States what passed, what failed, and what happens next.

artifact_type.description: The schema ID of the artifact that was verified (e.g. spec@1)

retry_count.description: How many times this artifact has been through the gate. Escalate at 3.
